title: Decibels
idea: Decibels describe a power change. Double the power is +3 dB, ten times is +10 dB, and half is -3 dB.

traps.why: +10 dB is ten times the power. Doubling is only +3 dB.
-3 dB is half the power. 12 W to 3 W is a quarter: half (6 W) and half again (3 W), so -6 dB.
12 to 6 to 3 is two halvings, not three. Two halvings is -6 dB.
20 W to 200 W is exactly ten times the power, and ten times is +10 dB.
